entities.name: Assault on Rath
entities.description: The event of 4205 AR in which the Weatherlight crew enter Rath to rescue their captain Sisay and recover the Legacy.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: The plane ruled by Volrath, whose Stronghold lies beneath a desert of flowstone and which is absorbing Dominaria.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: The skyship that enters Rath to rescue Sisay.

entities.name: Weatherlight Crew
entities.description: The crew of the Weatherlight, led by Gerrard Capashen.

entities.name: Sisay
entities.description: The captain of the Weatherlight, whose abduction sets the assault in motion.

entities.name: Gerrard Capashen
entities.description: Leader of the Weatherlight crew, who falls from the ship, is saved by Selenia, and leads the rescue.

entities.name: Greven il-Vec
entities.description: Commander of the Predator, who ambushes the Weatherlight and throws Vhati overboard.

entities.name: Predator
entities.description: Greven's airship that ambushes and later chases the Weatherlight.

entities.name: Vhati il-Dal
entities.description: Greven's mutinous first mate, who fires on the Weatherlight and dies impaled by a branch after Greven throws him off.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A pacifist golem and part of the Legacy, imprisoned in Volrath's dungeon and later rescued.

entities.name: Selenia
entities.description: A powerful angel serving Volrath who catches Gerrard, and who is struck down by Crovax, her form entering his body.

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: The ruler of Rath who plans a full-scale invasion and taunts Gerrard in the Dream Halls.

entities.name: Tahngarth
entities.description: A minotaur of the crew, captured by Greven and mutated, later rescued and a hero of the escape.

entities.name: Hanna
entities.description: The Weatherlight's navigator, who kills a shapeshifter and drags the Predator into the Stronghold.

entities.name: Orim
entities.description: A healer who tends the wounded and mourns Crovax's fate.

entities.name: Mirri
entities.description: A cat warrior who bonds with Hanna and sacrifices herself fighting Crovax so Gerrard may live.

entities.name: Eladamri
entities.description: An elf who helps plan the attack on the Stronghold.

entities.name: Oracle en-Vec
entities.description: An oracle who accompanies Gerrard and warns Starke that betrayal brings no lasting gain.

entities.name: Starke il-Vec
entities.description: A crew member who fears his past as a defector and his betrayal of Sisay will be exposed.

entities.name: Crovax
entities.description: A crew member who kills shapeshifters, strikes down Selenia, and is transformed into a vampire.

entities.name: Ertai
entities.description: The ship's mage who makes a deal with Lyna and is left behind on Rath.

entities.name: Lyna
entities.description: A Soltari emissary who strikes a deal with Ertai.

entities.name: Squee
entities.description: The goblin cabin boy who accidentally activates the Salvation Sphere.

entities.name: Tomalan
entities.description: A crewman who severs the Predator's harpoon lines and is shot and killed.

entities.name: Sliver Queen
entities.description: A being in the Stronghold with whom Karn forms a bond, letting him reclaim the Legacy pieces.

entities.name: The Legacy
entities.description: A set of artifacts the Weatherlight crew carries and seeks to reclaim from Volrath.

entities.name: Skyshaper
entities.description: An artifact Karn retrieves that enhances the ship's speed.

entities.name: The Stronghold
entities.description: Volrath's fortress on Rath.

entities.name: Skyshroud Forest
entities.description: The forest where the Weatherlight crash-lands and Gerrard falls.

entities.name: Furnace of Rath
entities.description: A fiery, dangerous back passage into the Stronghold where slivers attack.

entities.name: Dream Halls
entities.description: A place in the Stronghold where Gerrard sees visions and where Selenia is struck down.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: A watcher of the assault's end alongside Lyna.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane that Rath is absorbing.

events.summary: The Weatherlight enters Rath's atmosphere to rescue Sisay, led by Gerrard.
events.quote: Skyship Weatherlight entered its dangerous atmosphere far above the desert of deadly flowstone

events.summary: Greven's Predator ambushes the Weatherlight and Greven battles Gerrard.
events.quote: Greven and his crew ambushed the Weatherlight, boarding the ship and engaging in a fierce personal battle with Gerrard.

events.summary: Vhati fires on the Weatherlight, capsizing it and sending Gerrard tumbling from the deck.
events.quote: Gerrard was sent tumbling from the deck, falling through a long stretch of open air.

events.summary: Selenia catches Gerrard mid-air but he wrests free and falls into the forest canopy.
events.quote: Gerrard was caught mid-air by Selenia

events.summary: Greven throws Vhati off the Predator and Vhati is impaled by a branch.
events.quote: Vhati met his end as he was impaled by a branch

events.summary: Greven's moggs loot the Legacy artifacts, including Karn.
events.quote: ordered his moggs to loot the artifacts of the Legacy

events.summary: The Weatherlight crash-lands in Skyshroud and Tahngarth is caught by Greven before he can rescue Karn.
events.quote: was caught by Greven before he could rescue Karn.

events.summary: Hanna kills a shapeshifter, then she and Mirri are captured by Skyshroud elves.
events.quote: they were soon captured by Skyshroud elves.

events.summary: Gerrard returns with Eladamri and the Oracle, having been saved by Selenia, and plans to rescue the captives and reclaim the Legacy.
events.quote: revealing that he had been saved by Selenia before managing to escape.

events.summary: Starke considers murdering the Oracle but her guards spoil the opportunity.
events.quote: He considered murdering her, but something kept him off long enough for her guards to spoil the opportunity.

events.summary: Starke, fearing exposure of his betrayal of Sisay, decides to act against his crew.
events.quote: made a fateful decision to act against his crew.

events.summary: Ertai strikes a deal with the Soltari emissary Lyna to open the portal.
events.quote: Ertai made a deal with Lyna

events.summary: Squee accidentally activates the Salvation Sphere, driving off Volrath's undead attackers in the Death Pits.
events.quote: the goblin cabin boy Squee accidentally activate the Salvation Sphere

events.summary: Crovax brutally kills a shapeshifter in Selenia's form.
events.quote: Crovax, in a fit of rage, brutally killed a shapeshifter

events.summary: Karn refuses to fight when taken to witness Tahngarth's mutation.
events.quote: refused to fight, believing that remorse would outlast rage.

events.summary: The rescue party frees Karn and Tahngarth, but the 'Sisay' they find is a shapeshifter.
events.quote: They successfully freed Karn and Tahngarth

events.summary: In the Dream Halls Crovax strikes down the real Selenia, her shattered form entering him and making him a vampire.
events.quote: In a moment of deep regret, Crovax struck her down

events.summary: Karn encounters the Sliver Queen and claims the Legacy pieces.
events.quote: Karn encountered the Sliver Queen in her lair

events.summary: Tomalan severs the Predator's harpoon lines and is killed.
events.quote: Tomalan severed the harpoon lines before being shot and killed.

events.summary: Hanna drags the Predator into a collision with the Stronghold.
events.quote: Hanna, acting quickly, managed to drag the Predator into a collision with the Stronghold.

events.summary: Tahngarth leaps onto the final ornithopter and crashes it before leaping to safety.
events.quote: Tahngarth climbed a tree and leaped onto the enemy craft

events.summary: Gerrard realizes Rath is absorbing Dominaria, then defeats Sisay and Takara set against him by Volrath.
events.quote: Gerrard realized that Rath was absorbing Dominaria itself.

events.summary: Mirri sacrifices herself fighting Crovax so Gerrard can escape.
events.quote: she sacrificed herself, allowing Gerrard to live.

events.summary: The Weatherlight crosses the portal boosted by the Skyshaper, leaving Ertai behind on Rath.
events.quote: he was unable to save him, leaving him behind on Rath.

events.summary: The Predator crashes into the portal, tumbling Ertai at Greven's feet, ending the assault.
events.quote: The Predator crashed into the portal, sending Ertai tumbling at Greven il-Vec

relations.note: The crew is led by Gerrard.

relations.quote: Greven turned on Vhati, throwing him off the Predator

relations.note: She sought to bring Gerrard to Volrath.
relations.quote: who sought to bring him to Volrath

relations.note: Crovax strikes her down in the Dream Halls.

relations.quote: Their bond strengthened in this moment
engaging in a fierce personal battle with Gerrard.

relations.note: They agree a deal to open the portal.
relations.quote: Ertai made a deal with Lyna

relations.note: Volrath is the ruler of Rath.
